notes.rmd160: RIPEMD160(SHA256(compressed_pubkey)) as big-endian int; all 160 from catalog
notes.sha256_pubkey: SHA256(compressed pubkey); only when pubkey known
notes.checksum4: first 4 bytes of sha256_chk as uint32; all 160
notes.limbs: Px/Py/Pmy/r/s/z/Ry only when pubkey and/or rsz available
notes.neg_y: (-Py) mod p; equals Pmy for affine points on the curve
notes.y2_mod_p: Py^2 mod p (erases Cp carry — reference only)
notes.x3_plus_7_mod_p: Px^3 + 7 mod p (erases Cp carry — reference only)
notes.rmd160_cubed_plus_7_mod_p: hash160^3 + 7 mod p (formal analogue; not a curve law)
